analysis_trace.content: NCT06551181 is a Phase 3 bridging study evaluating RSVPreF3 OA vaccine (GSK Arexvy) in adults >=60 years, comparing immunogenicity between Overseas and China groups. The study assesses RSV-A and RSV-B neutralization titers (GMTs) and seroresponse rates at Day 31.

Adults 60 years and older, divided into RSV OA vaccine Group (Overseas), RSV OA vaccine Group (China), and Placebo Group (China). This is a bridging immunogenicity study typical for regulatory approval in China.

RSVPreF3 OA contains recombinant RSV prefusion F protein (RSVPreF3) adjuvanted with AS01E. The vaccine induces neutralizing antibodies against RSV-A and RSV-B subtypes. This mechanism is well-established with proven efficacy in Phase 3 AReSVi-006 study (NEJM 2023).

Primary endpoints: GMT ratios (Overseas vs China) and seroresponse rate differences for RSV-A and RSV-B at Day 31. Secondary endpoints include GMTs at multiple timepoints and comparisons to prior study RSV OA=ADJ-006. Success requires GMT ratio within predefined equivalence bounds (typically 0.5-2.0) and similar seroresponse rates.

Safety endpoints (solicited/unsolicited AEs, SAEs, pIMDs) are secondary. Arexvy has established safety profile from prior Phase 3 data: generally well-tolerated with mild-to-moderate reactogenicity, rare serious events. No safety signals identified in prior studies.

Evidence from J Infect Dis 2024 (Phase 3 immunogenicity study) shows RSVPreF3 OA achieves GMTs >10,000 IU/mL for RSV-A and >8,000 IU/mL for RSV-B at Day 31 with seroresponse rates >90%. AReSVi-006 demonstrated 94.1% efficacy against RSV-LRTD. Bridging studies typically show consistent immunogenicity across regions.

Potential risks: lower immune response in China population due to baseline differences, though unlikely given protein subunit vaccine mechanism. Co-administration effects not relevant here as this appears to be standalone vaccination.

Based on established Phase 3 data, RSVPreF3 OA consistently shows high GMTs and seroresponse rates. GMT ratios between Overseas and China groups are expected to fall within equivalence bounds (0.67-1.5). Seroresponse rates should exceed 85% in both groups with minimal between-group differences (<10 percentage points).

Endpoints secondary-6/7: Seroresponse rates for RSV-A/RSV-B at Day 31 and Day 181
Endpoints secondary-8/9: GMT comparison between China group and ADJ-006 immunogenicity subset
Endpoints secondary-10/11: Seroresponse rate comparison between China group and ADJ-006 subset
Evidence base: Multiple Phase 3 studies (AReSVi-006, co-administration studies) show RSVPreF3 OA induces robust neutralizing antibody responses
Published data from AReSVi-006 and related trials show seroresponse rates ~80-95% for both RSV-A and RSV-B at 1 month post-vaccination
GMT fold rises typically 8-15x from baseline in older adults, with GMT values in range of 3000-5000 for RSV-A and 6000-9000 for RSV-B at Day 31
Persistence data show GMTs decline by 6 months but remain above baseline
Bridging to China population: No direct published immunogenicity data for Chinese older adults as of 2026-01-31

matches.human_readable_report: NCT06551181 是 RSV PreF3 OA 疫苗（AS01E 佐剂）在中国 60 岁及以上人群的 3 期免疫原性桥接研究，Gold 按 OG000（China）/OG001（Overseas 或 ADJ-006 免疫原性子集）/OG002（第三组）报告，共 14 个 endpoint 有行。kimi 模型输出 22/23 个 slot（缺 secondary-22），核心数值发现是免疫原性绝对量级系统性高估：primary-0 组 GMT 12000/11500 对 Gold adjusted 5676.7/6329.5（高估约一倍），secondary-4 的 Day 31 12000 对 unadjusted 5523.2/6604.5（CI 下限 8000 已高于 Gold 上限），seroresponse 0.90-0.92 对 Gold 77.3/76.9 与 69.5/70.3（高估约 13-20 个百分点）。方向层好坏参半：Overseas 略高的主方向（primary-0）与接种后 GMT 上升、征集部位/全身事件疫苗组更多（secondary-14 的 65% 对 15% 与 Gold secondary-17 的 497 对 25 形态一致）等判断正确；但 primary-1/primary-2 的组间排序反向，secondary-7 称 "RSV-B responses typically exceed RSV-A" 而 Gold 中 RSV-B seroresponse（69.5-70.3）低于 RSV-A（76.9-77.3），secondary-10 的非劣效差 0（CI -5 至 5）漏掉了 China 对 ADJ-006 的 RSV-B 差 -9.1 个百分点。结构性问题集中在安全区段：模型 secondary-14 至 21 的内容与 Gold secondary-17 至 22 行号整体偏移（征集部位、征集全身、非征集、SAE、pIMD、致命各自错位），且模型把安全终点压成 All study groups 单组而 Gold 为三组；secondary-12/13 预测了 RT-PCR 确认 RSV ARI/LRTD 事件（1 对 8、1 对 6）而 Gold 无任何 ARI/LRTD 行，属无结果侧依据的效力想象。亮点是若干计数型安全终点量级判断好：secondary-20 相关 pIMD 0.0 对 Gold 相关行 0/0 精确吻合，secondary-19 相关 SAE 3.0（CI 1.0-8.0）对 Gold 合计 4 例。过程侧 audit 显示 22 turns、blocked 16、returned 147、dropped_after_cutoff 2、max_doc_date 2026-01-28、verdict PASS，但 5 次 fetch 全零、中国本地定标证据缺失；模型 trial_outcome 给 success 0.85，与绝对值系统性高估、多处方向反向的现实相比明显过度自信。三轴结论：prediction_accuracy 57.8、analysis_quality 67.0、search_quality 64.0，无综合分。该样本的典型失败模式是：海外 3 期先验未经本地量级校准直接迁移，叠加安全 slot 的行号错位，使输出表面完整而锚定与映射双失。
